story_info.title: Penny Penguin's Happy Brush
story_info.subtitle: A Story about Healthy Habits
story_info.moral: Brushing your teeth keeps them clean and makes you feel good.

main_character.name: Penny Penguin
main_character.appearance: Penny is a small round penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, and orange webbed feet. She has rosy cheeks and a cheerful, energetic stance.

cover.prompt: Pixar-quality 3D, Soft lighting, Pastel colours, Children's book illustration, Vertical composition, Instagram friendly. Penny Penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, orange webbed feet, and rosy cheeks, holding a small blue toothbrush with a happy, energetic smile in her cozy washroom. Her teeth are clean and sparkly.
cover.visual_action: Penny Penguin happily brushing her clean teeth

slides.title: Morning Fun
slides.text: The morning sun felt warm in Penny Penguin's cozy home. She woke up with a happy stretch. "Good morning, day!" she chirped. Penny ate her healthy breakfast. Fresh fish made her feel strong. She smiled, ready for play.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Penny Penguin waking up in her home, feeling happy after breakfast.

slides.title: Time to Play!
slides.text: After her healthy breakfast, Penny Penguin felt full of energy. She saw her shiny red ball. "Time to play outside!" she cheered. Penny hopped to the door. But then she paused. Her bright smile faded a little. She remembered something important.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Penny almost leaving to play but pausing as she remembers something.

slides.title: A Healthy Habit
slides.text: "My teeth!" Penny remembered. After eating, tiny food bits can hide. Clean teeth keep her smile bright. Penny knew this healthy habit was important. She went to her little washroom. Time to make her mouth feel fresh.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny realizes she forgot to brush her teeth and heads to the washroom.

slides.title: Brush, Brush, Brush!
slides.text: Penny found her tiny blue toothbrush. She put a small spot of paste on it. "Brush, brush, brush!" she sang a happy song. She brushed up and down. She brushed side to side. Every tooth became shiny.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny happily brushes her teeth, making it a fun activity.

slides.title: A Happy Smile
slides.text: Penny rinsed her mouth with water. "Healthy habits make every day fun!" she cheered. Her teeth felt so clean and fresh. Penny flashed a big, bright smile. She felt strong and happy. Now she was ready for any fun adventure!
slides.speaker_notes: Penny feels good and proud after brushing, ready for the day.
